verdict: The find path is still fundamentally the same broken funnel the original report described — refinements are discarded via verbatim-echo or an incorrectly-firing verify-wall, and most metro/out-of-coverage moms still get looped on a ZIP they already gave. The one genuine improvement is that ZIP coverage silently widened beyond just 32827, though this isn't reflected in the metro empty-state messaging, which still only offers 32827 as an example.
